dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides a detailed six‑layer evaluation tree, concrete condition‑key examples, and an 8‑item root‑cause catalog that a senior CloudOps engineer would find new. Missing deeper coverage of newer Access Analyzer validation steps and IAM Identity Center session‑policy nuances, so not a perfect 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific diagnostic order (SCP → resource → identity → boundary → session → service‑linked) and exact CLI commands. Lacks an explicit step for VPC endpoint policy verification, which is a notable AWS‑specific procedure.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Provides a thorough NEVER list with concrete pitfalls (wildcard Allow, assuming identity‑policy is the only cause, ignoring VPC endpoint policies, etc.) and clear reasoning why each is dangerous. Missing only a few niche anti‑patterns (e.g., IAM policy size limits), so one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter includes all required fields, description, when_to_use, activation_triggers, and a textual invocation_schema. The skill description fully explains WHAT it does, WHEN to invoke, and KEYWORDS.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level sections give concise activation and quick reference; deeper details (process, edge cases, remediation) are layered later. Slight overload in the long Process section prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Diagnostic steps are tightly constrained (require CloudTrail or simulator before proceeding) and never perform destructive changes. Freedom is well‑calibrated to the fragility of IAM troubleshooting.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a clear, repeatable pattern (Activation → Mindset → Quick reference → Process → Output → Commands → Edge cases → Anti‑Patterns → Remediation), matching established troubleshooting skill structures.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a deterministic decision tree, concrete CLI commands, and a worked example, enabling an agent to act. Lacks a machine‑parseable invocation schema and omits guidance for pagination or permission errors when running CLI commands.
